items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Joe drove me to Pittsburgh, and then we formed a band in Pittsburgh called the Eldridge Brothers Rhythm Kings.

ctx.x: No, what happened was that... It was a time that I was with Connie's Hot Chocolates on the road. And I got a wire from my buddy telling me, don't come back to New York, they're waiting for me at the station, at the airport, anywhere I'd come in, you know. So I went to Pittsburgh. It was something to do with a chick, I don't know...

Joe drove me to Pittsburgh, and then we formed a band in Pittsburgh called the Eldridge Brothers Rhythm Kings. That was an interesting little thing. We had a gig... Oh, one of the first gigs. But we had a good band.
